tools.name: vehicle_recalls
tools.description: Are there recalls on this car? Lists every US safety recall NHTSA holds for a make, model and model year, newest first, with the faulty component, the risk, the remedy and do-not-drive or park-outside warnings. tools.name: recall_campaign_details
tools.description: Look up one recall by its NHTSA campaign number (for example 20V314000, as printed on a US recall letter) and get the defect, risk, remedy, the number of vehicles potentially affected and every make, model and year it covers. For owners, journalists, lawyers and fleet managers. Source: NHTSA Recalls

tools.name: vehicle_complaints
tools.description: What goes wrong with this car? Summarises owner-filed safety complaints to NHTSA for a make, model and model year: total complaints, crashes, fires, injuries and deaths reported, the most-complained-about components, and the latest complaints with their text. For used-car buyers, owners and research

tools.name: complaint_by_odi_number
tools.description: Read one NHTSA owner safety complaint by its ODI number: vehicle, components, crash, fire, injuries and deaths reported, incident and filing dates, partial VIN and the owner's own description. For lawyers, investigators, journalists and owners following up a complaint found with vehicle_complaints.

tools.name: vehicle_crash_ratings
tools.description: How safe is this car in a crash? Returns the US NCAP 5-Star Safety Ratings for a make, model and model year, one entry per body style or drivetrain: overall, frontal (driver and passenger), side barrier and side pole, and rollover stars with the rollover risk percentage. tools.name: vehicle_driver_assist_features
tools.description: Does this car have lane departure warning or forward collision warning as standard? Returns whether electronic stability control, forward collision warning and lane departure warning are standard, optional or not available, per body style, for a make, model and model year.
